task: MR19 补测之四：托管程序集是否也受路径影响（头条结论的跨路径检验）
closes: the fact that MR19 headline claim (managed assembly byte-reproducible) was only ever tested at ONE path
verdict: NEGATIVE - the managed assembly is ALSO path-dependent; the milestone headline must be narrowed to "same path"

result.design: one snapshot copied to three EQUAL-LENGTH (98 char) paths: C: pgA, C: pgB (one char different), D: 95 d's; bin/obj cleaned before each publish
result.control: rebuilding at the SAME path about 2 minutes later reproduced both the DLL and the exe byte-for-byte, so TIME is ruled out as the cause - the difference is attributable to the PATH
result.exeFirstDiff: A vs B (same drive, content differs) 0x9AD088 with 85 differing bytes; A vs C (cross-drive, same length) 0x9AD088 with 176 differing bytes
result.zero1ACDriveHypothesis: NOT SUPPORTED - the cross-drive same-length comparison first differs at 0x9AD088, not 0x1AC; 0x1AC appeared only once (round 27 D:-in-place vs C:-temp) and was not reproduced
result.pdb: differs across all three paths - embedding source paths in a PDB is expected behaviour and is a separate matter from binary reproducibility

impactOnMR19: NOT USABLE: "managed assembly is byte-reproducible" without qualification
USABLE: managed assembly and single-file exe are byte-reproducible AT THE SAME PATH
USABLE: cross-path is NOT reproducible (for BOTH the managed assembly and the single-file exe)
NOT SUPPORTED: 0x1AC is a drive effect
selfFoundIssues: moving the snapshot tree was denied 11 times even after dotnet build-server shutdown (MSBuild nodes held the project directory) -> switched to COPYING three snapshots (5.3 MB each before build) and added /nodeReuse:false
Copy-Item -LiteralPath does not expand wildcards, so the first copy produced 0 files ("0.0 MB") -> switched to -Path
stillOpen: the cause of the 0x1AC difference (appeared once in round 27, not reproduced since)
the semantics of the scattered bytes around 0x9AD088
where the path string appears inside the managed assembly (the same string-search method from round 28 was NOT applied here)
